visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins at night on an urban street corner. A young man with dark hair, wearing a black face mask and a black oversized hoodie with a white cross detail, stands on the sidewalk. He holds a pack of wet wipes in both hands, looking down at them while talking. Behind him, a green traffic light glows against the dark sky, and a white car is parked nearby. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor shrimp fishing facility. The walls are brightly decorated with green and yellow geometric patterns. The man is now seated on a white plastic chair beside a large rectangular pond filled with dark water. He gestures toward a white fishing rod with his hands while looking directly at the camera. A brief animated image of a female anime character with a pink bow appears as an overlay. (3) A staff member wearing a red polo shirt and jeans walks past the pond carrying a white bucket, presumably to restock shrimp. The main character continues his commentary, pointing toward his fishing line in the water. Other patrons are visible sitting along the pond edge in the background. (4) The man pulls his fishing rod upward, successfully catching a grey shrimp that dangles from the hook. He brings the shrimp close to the camera for a close-up view. He smiles behind his mask and uses his hands to point at the catch. (5) The man crouches on the stone-tiled ledge of the pond. He points into the water at a shrimp swimming near the surface. He then reaches into the water with his bare right hand and successfully grabs the shrimp by its long antennae, lifting it out to show the camera. A young girl in a purple coat stands nearby, watching him. (6) He stands up, triumphantly holding the live shrimp by its whiskers, moving it toward the lens before the video cuts to a black screen.

A young male voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with an inquisitive tone, followed by a female voice responding. A high-energy electronic pop BGM with a synthesized beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. The male voice resumes, now in a more resonant, broadcast-like quality, confidently boasting about his fishing skills. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo in the background. (3) A comic 'boing' sound effect plays as the speaker makes a joke. This is followed by a digital 'ding' sound for emphasis. Low-level ambient noise of a public space and water splashing is audible under the dialogue. (4) A rapid sequence of comic sound effects (pings and bubbles) punctuates the speaker's excitement as he describes the fishing process. The rhythmic electronic beat of the BGM remains dominant. (5) A 'magic sparkle' SFX plays as the shrimp is caught. The male narrator's pitch rises in excitement. (6) Another splash sound and a short bubble SFX trigger a new phase. The narrator whispers conspiratorially before catching the shrimp by hand. The video ends with a final celebratory chime SFX.
